adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` calls `schema.safeParse(...)` and then immediately `throw new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` when `!refreshTokenResponse.success`. Therefore it only returns a result when `success === true`. In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the subsequent check `if (!accessTokenParsed.success) { ... }` after calling `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)` is unreachable/dead code (it will either throw before returning, or return a successful parse). This is a real diff-grounded issue but it’s not a functional defect—just redundant logic that can’t be covered by tests as written.
